title: File:VIELHA - VAL D'ARAN - IB-399.JPG
claims: The photograph is a daylight view of Vielha from the Salient viewpoint, showing dense low-rise buildings with slate roofs, streets, a river corridor, parking areas and surrounding wooded slopes; the file page gives the camera location as 42.706531 N, 0.808758 E.

Commons titles the photograph VIELHA - VAL D'ARAN - IB-399.JPG and describes it as Vielha seen from the Salient viewpoint; it shows the town environment, not the VDA start arch, finish line, aid station, timing mat, course marking or race-day crowd.
The author is Isidre blanc; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2015-07-24 at 13:33:59; the original is 2,048 x 1,536 pixels and 1,673,884 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 373,898 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Isidre blanc, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
